title: Unused packaging tools introduced high-severity findings in the runtime image
symptom: The container scan found vulnerable MessagePack and setuptools distributions in the backend runtime image.
impact: The image security gate failed even though the application lock selected a patched MessagePack and the runtime did not need either package.

root_cause.statement: Packaging tools inherited outside the locked production virtual environment remained visible in the final Python image.

solution_options.description: Uninstall MessagePack, setuptools, and pip from the final runtime stage before copying the locked application environment.
evidence: Trivy container job passed after removal
Application build and backend tests remained green
tradeoffs: Runtime debugging cannot rely on pip

solution_options.description: Keep the packaging tools but upgrade each to a patched release in the final image.
evidence: Patched versions were available for both findings
tradeoffs: Adds unnecessary packages and mutable installation behavior

checks: Trivy high and critical image scan

prevention: Scan the assembled runtime image, not only application lockfiles
Remove build and packaging tools that the running service does not require

requirements: Confirm the target runtime does not require package installation
Rebuild and scan the customer's exact image
